programme.title: The Dog Stars (2026)
programme.desc:
In a world devastated by a catastrophic pandemic, Hig, a pilot living at a remote airfield, has built a guarded existence alongside Bangley, a tough military survivalist. Their fragile safety is disrupted when a mysterious radio transmission offers the possibility of other survivors. Driven by grief, curiosity and the hope of human connection, Hig risks everything to fly beyond the boundaries of his isolated refuge, confronting dangers that test his instinct for survival and his faith in humanity.
Genre: Science Fiction, Post-Apocalyptic Thriller, Drama
Director: Ridley Scott Cast: Jacob Elordi, Josh Brolin, Margaret Qualley, Guy Pearce, Benedict Wong, Allison Janney

programme.title: Sense and Sensibility (2026)
programme.desc:
After their family fortunes change, sisters Elinor and Marianne Dashwood must navigate financial insecurity, social expectations and the uncertain prospect of marriage. Elinor tries to conceal her feelings behind composure and good judgment, while Marianne follows her heart with passionate openness. As each faces disappointment and unexpected possibilities, the sisters discover the value of balancing reason with emotion in this new adaptation of Jane Austen's beloved novel.
Genre: Period Drama, Romance
Director: Georgia Oakley Cast: Daisy Edgar-Jones, Esmé Creed-Miles, Caitríona Balfe, Frank Dillane, George MacKay, Fiona Shaw
